en: The postcard features two black-and-white photographic views. The left shows a street scene with a striking historical building, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century, with trees and a curved tram or train line. The right image shows a park featuring a medieval tower, identified as 'Kronenburgerpark', with lush greenery and a river or pond. There is handwritten text in Dutch on the bottom and right side. Printed text reads 'Nijmegen' and 'Kronenburgerpark'. On the left border, there is a printer's mark: 'Lichtdruk Schalekamp P. Buiksloot'.
